name: Tyndryn
description: A child of Arboria taught by Alzarakh to summon an Ironroot Treefolk, then killed by his pursuers.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyndryn's summoning alerts Alzarakh's pursuers, who kill her; the locals execute Alzarakh with green magic.
timeline.quote: From the sky a terrible attack shoots out, killing the child.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Not Just Another Green World? , by Peter Friend". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
